agyos_skill.instructions: The **annual moment-planning** skill — map the few moments that fit, gate them for **fit + authenticity**, **tier** by weight, and **plan far ahead.** The planned counterpart to `trend-jacking`. The agent **plans**; big commercial moments → `campaign-and-launch-planning`; **WoopSocial schedules the planned content ahead.** Brands fail the calendar two ways: **ignore it** (miss the tailwind of moments that already have attention) or **blanket-post every "national [x] day"** (hollow, off-brand spam → sometimes backlash). The top-1% move: **"not every holiday deserves a post, and not every brand deserves a voice in every conversation."** Pick the **few that fit your brand + audience + commercial calendar**, tier them, and **plan in advance** — the predictable counterpart to `trend-jacking`'s reactivity. The question is **"does this make sense for our brand, audience, and goals?"** — *silence on the wrong day beats noise on the wrong topic.* 1. **brand-profile** — voice/identity/standing. 2. **audience-research** — what the audience cares about + when. (Depth: `references/the-dates-framework.md`.) - **D — Decide the moments that matter:** build YOUR brand's calendar (seasons, retail anchors, relevant awareness months, industry events, milestones) — not every internet holiday. - **A — Audit for fit + standing:** fit gate (brand/audience/goals) + authenticity gate (identity/cause moments need **genuine year-round commitment**; "why us, why this moment?" or **stay quiet** — no rainbow-washing). - **T — Tier by weight + sensitivity:** Tier 1 commercial/fun (go) · Tier 2 authentic-alignment-required · Tier 3 cultural/solemn (non-promotional respect). Big commercial = a campaign → `campaign-and-launch- planning`. - **E — Engineer it early:** 8–12 weeks ahead (major) / 2–4 (minor); run big moments as a multi-week series, not one post. - **S — Slot it in + measure:** feed the `content-calendar`; **schedule ahead via WoopSocial**; leave ~50% open for `trend-jacking`; measure vs the moment's goal; quarterly review. Lead times: major 8–12 wk / minor 2–4 wk; brief Back-to-School in May, Halloween in Aug; quarterly (13-wk)
